The user now needs to send a text message, and first must enter the interface to start a conversation. The current interface has a clickable TextView labeled "Start a conversation," so the first step should be to click it to enter the interface for selecting a contact or entering a number. Therefore, a Tap action should be performed on the corresponding element. We need to find the bounds of this element, which, according to the structure, are [286, 168, 711, 227], so we will execute the Tap action.


do(action="Tap", element=[500,203])
